attributes.readMe:
## Severity Badge

Renders a severity level as a pill with a three-segment meter and the label; `critical` is solid. The meter carries the rank on its own, so minor / major / critical stay distinguishable when colour does not — a legibility requirement, not decoration.

```hbs
<SeverityBadge @level={{finding.severity.level}} />
<SeverityBadge @level='major' @count={{3}} />
<SeverityBadge @level='critical' @compact={{true}} />
```

Args: `@level` (minor / major / critical; anything else renders nothing), `@count` (trailing tally, for roll-ups), `@compact` (meter and count only, for table cells and fitted tiles). Colour comes from `SEVERITY_HUE` through `stateColor`, so a linked theme moves fill and text together. Built on boxel-ui's `Pill`; only the meter and the hue mapping are this block's.

## Example
`SeverityBadgeExample/showcase` shows every level in every mode, plus a real Severity field rendered embedded and atom.

## Non-goals
Does not decide severity or read the record it sits on — it is handed a level. Not a generic state pill (see State Pill); the meter is severity-specific. No click behaviour.
